title: Make My Photo Look Professional
tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: The edit delivers a polished, realistic professional portrait with the man's recognizable features preserved, smart clothing, and a neutral backdrop.

must_haves.item: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
must_haves.why: His short grey hair, eyes, nose, facial contours, and grey stubble remain recognizable.

must_haves.item: His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
must_haves.why: He now wears a white collared shirt and a dark blazer.

must_haves.item: The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
must_haves.why: The kitchen is fully replaced by a plain, softly shaded grey background.

must_haves.item: Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
must_haves.why: Facial highlights are more controlled, with natural-looking directional lighting and visible wrinkles, skin texture, and stubble.

must_haves.item: The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.
must_haves.why: The framing is clean, and the hair edges, clothing, and face show no obvious editing artifacts.
